captions.text: LastCopy checks whether field answers and photos reached the server. The originals stay unchanged.
The illustration follows your scroll. It explains a copy check; it does not claim a live recovery.
Sample: authored synthetic files, compared by the real offline verifier. One referenced photo is missing.
Open the original file, exact XML occurrence and evidence receipt. File hashes are available for inspection.
Review the exact operation and untouched files. This Sample bundle does not upload anything.
Sample readback uses a separate authored fixture. Its matching result is not presented as a real server write.
Replay: this captured Connected investigation made actual Zetaris queries and real Nightshift calls. Opening it makes no provider calls.
The reviewer requested original XML. World Model reads changed the next action to export guidance: do not resubmit.
The second captured investigation kept conflicting answers unresolved. It did not schedule an overwrite.
Real Central recovery was checked again on 26 October. Fresh XML and media matched; repeat Apply made no upload or duplicate.
Correct control: the original remains in history beside an intentional server edit. Recovery must preserve that edit.
Try LastCopy without an account at lastcopy-five.vercel.app/demo. The hosted core works while the PC is off; local sponsor runtime remains separate.
